import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

print("mpl from:", matplotlib.__file__)

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, subplot_kw={'projection': '3d'})
ax1.scatter(1, 1, 1)
ax2.scatter(1, 1, 1, c='r')
ax1.set_visible(False)
fig.canvas.draw()
buf = np.asarray(fig.canvas.buffer_rgba())

# reference 1: same figure but ax1 visible -> must differ from buf
fig_v, (b1, b2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, subplot_kw={'projection': '3d'})
b1.scatter(1, 1, 1)
b2.scatter(1, 1, 1, c='r')
fig_v.canvas.draw()
buf_v = np.asarray(fig_v.canvas.buffer_rgba())

# reference 2: ax1 empty AND invisible -> buf must equal this
fig_e, (c1, c2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, subplot_kw={'projection': '3d'})
c1.set_visible(False)
c2.scatter(1, 1, 1, c='r')
fig_e.canvas.draw()
buf_e = np.asarray(fig_e.canvas.buffer_rgba())

ok1 = not np.array_equal(buf, buf_v)
ok2 = np.array_equal(buf, buf_e)
print("invisible ax1 differs from visible ax1:", ok1)
print("invisible ax1 == empty invisible ax1:", ok2)
print("RESULT:", "PASS" if (ok1 and ok2) else "FAIL")
